headline: Price range
body: Here is a price range. It depends on the assumptions below.

clauses.text: Size 6.0 m x 7.0 m (42 m²) as stated
clauses.if_not_true: Re-quote at the rate-card price for the actual size

clauses.text: Clearance height up to the rate card's standard height
clauses.if_not_true: Height surcharge from the rate card; above its maximum, site measure

clauses.text: Freestanding posts fixed to existing paving or concrete
clauses.if_not_true: Footing variation from the rate card; soil or slope, site measure

clauses.text: Level site with vehicle access for installation
Roof covering is one of the options in the range
clauses.if_not_true: Range narrows to the chosen covering

clauses.text: Excludes municipal building plan approval, where required
Excludes electrical work and gate automation
This price is valid for 14 days.
clauses.if_not_true: After expiry, re-quote at the current rate card

clauses.text: A range or default-based price becomes fixed only after site measure confirms the assumptions
clauses.if_not_true: Final price follows the measured assumptions

clauses.text: No installation date is reserved until the 30% deposit is paid.
